notes: BUU v3.0.7 - your flows travel with the installer. Every build packages the flow library from the machine it was built on, and on first launch after any install or update BUU copies in any flow the local machine does not already have - install on a VM or fresh machine and your whole library is there. Existing flows are NEVER overwritten (local edits win; delete a flow's .json and relaunch to re-pull the bundled copy). Includes 3.0.5/3.0.6: installers can never delete flows/logs/failures/schedules, the updater backs data up before installing, the first-open update check retries through connection resets, and start mode saves with each flow so Run all flows run unattended including on schedules.
